title: Light Syrian Dum Bouncy-Qq
description: A light, peppery Syrian dish featuring bouncy-qq dumplings with a tangy cider vinegar twist.

ingredients.name: bouncy-qq dumpling wrappers
ingredients.notes: Available at Asian markets or online.

instructions: Combine flour, water, salt, and black pepper in a mixing bowl and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into 12 equal pieces and roll into balls.
Place a bouncy-qq dumpling wrapper on a flat surface and place a dough ball in the center.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper, then fold the wrapper into a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer dumplings to a plate and serve with a drizzle of cider vinegar and chopped parsley.
